## Latest Release

### Version 1.2.0 (21/09/2026)

**Your projects**

- New **Backup** button in the launcher header: export the projects of PyPotteryLens, PyPotteryScan and PyPotteryTrace to a single `.zip` file, and import them back on any installation. You choose which projects to save, and what to do when one already exists (keep both, replace it, or skip it)
- **Updating or reinstalling a module no longer deletes its projects.** Before, an update replaced the whole module folder, projects included. Uninstalling a module or the suite still removes them, so the uninstall confirmation and the Windows uninstaller now say so and point to Backup

**Interface**

- The module cards, the start and install dialogs and the changelog now use the new logos without the written name
- The changelog panel shows the release notes written in the documentation
- Fonts, icons and the Excel export library are served from the launcher itself, so it looks the same without an internet connection
- The downloaded AI models list shows the YOLO and classifier weights as used by PyPotteryLens

**For testers**

- **Beta channel**: set `PYPOTTERY_CHANNEL=beta` (or put a `channel.txt` containing `beta` next to the launcher) to install the modules from their `beta` branch instead of the latest release. The channel is read again at every install


## Version History

### Version 1.1.0 (31/07/2026)

- Added **Developer Mode**: run sub-apps directly from their local git checkout instead of a downloaded copy, for contributors working on the source
- The launcher now shuts itself down (and stops any running app) automatically when its browser tab is closed
- Live "Check Updates" now correctly refreshes installed version numbers when running from a local git checkout

### Version 1.0.2 (27/12/2025)

- Improved upgrade process
- Minor UI improvements

### Version 1.0.1 (11/12/2025)

- Minor bug fixes:
    - Fixed issue with PyPotteryLens not starting
    - Reduced update checker cache duration to 2 hours


### Version 1.0.0 (December 2025)

- Initial release
